title: Bala ke Gham uthaye jaa rahe hai
body:
Karbala k dasht mein, alqama ke saamne..(2)
ghar nabi ka lut gaya
<<MINI>>
bala ke ghum uthaye jaa rahe hai..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
jafa ke teer khaye jaa rahe hai..(2)
<<MINI>>
bala ke ghum uthaye jaa rahe hai..(2)

bala ke ghum uthaye jaa rahe hai..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Qadam doshe nabuwat par the jinke..(2)

3. Jaha'n be izn aate the na jibreel..(2)

<<MINI>>
bala ke ghum uthaye jaa rahe hai..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Bithate the nabi kandho pe jinko..(2)

bala ke ghum uthaye jaa rahe hai..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Hua tha jaun qaem jinse parda..(2)
